title: Spanish Inquisition Begins
description:
The **Spanish Inquisition** was established in 1478 by Catholic Monarchs Ferdinand II and Isabella I to maintain Catholic orthodoxy.

The Inquisition investigated and prosecuted individuals accused of heresy. Methods included torture, confiscation of property, and execution by burning at the stake.

The Spanish Inquisition lasted over 350 years, officially ending in 1834. It became infamous for religious persecution and human rights abuses.
